props.title: Named Slots
props.description: Record-form children map slot names to elements; the parent component renders each slot at a different position.
props.technicalDescription:
Spec
CaseContainer → [Page with children { header, sidebar[3], content, footer }] + [SlotCard repeat: /cards with { title, body } slots]
State
{ cards: [{ title, body }, { title, body }] } (static)
Features
• Named slots — record-form children; each slot renders where the component places it
• Array slots — sidebar holds three elements in one slot
• Repeat + slots — one SlotCard instance per item, each with its own scoped title/body slots
• SlotText — reads a field relative to its repeat scope via usePath()

props.text: 📌 Page header — placed via the header slot

Main content — rendered in the content slot, to the right of the sidebar. Note the spec declares header first, but this element still renders in the middle: the component decides where each slot goes.
© Footer — rendered below everything via the footer slot
